$comment: Trans Afrique — the expedition. Afrinkong's signature product and deliberately not one of the eight experiences: an experience is a lens you look at the continent through, and this is a thing you do with a month of your life. Putting it in the grid would have made it the ninth tile in a row of eight.
$why_here: The homepage asks 'what do you want to feel', then shows what there is to see. Trans Afrique is the escalation after both: why choose one country at all. Tourist, then traveller, then explorer — and the section has to feel like the site opening into something else, or it is just a longer holiday.
$money: No figure is typed here. The daily rate comes from tourism/rates.json — the same file the ground journey is priced from — so an expedition cannot quote a number the rest of the site disagrees with. What is stated is the tier and the length; the arithmetic is done at build time and shown as a from.
name: Trans Afrique
line: Don’t just visit Africa. Cross it.
say: One continent, several countries, one journey that does not stop at a border. Weeks on the road with a team that stays with you — a driver who knows the route, specialists who live where you are going, and on selected expeditions a medical professional travelling with the group.
$team: Stated carefully. Drivers and local specialists are on every expedition. Medical accompaniment is written as 'on selected expeditions' and nowhere else, because it depends on the route, the season and who is available, and a site that promises a doctor on every crossing has promised something it cannot always deliver.

team.who: A driver for the whole crossing
team.say: The same one from the first border to the last. They have driven it before.
People who live where you are, joining for the stretch they know and handing over to the next.
Permits, borders, fuel, beds, and the plan when one of those does not work.
Where the route, the season and the group make it right. Confirmed before you book, never assumed.

$routes: Three, and the third is honestly open-ended. Every country named is one the atlas already carries, so an expedition cannot promise a border the rest of the site has never written up.

routes.name: The East African Crossing
routes.say: Rift lakes, two gorilla forests and the migration, overland and in that order.
routes.shape: Nairobi to Arusha, the long way round.

routes.name: The Southern Crossing
routes.say: Desert to delta to the falls, across five borders and most of a continent’s weather.

routes.name: The Great Africa Expedition
routes.say: Built around you, from wherever you want to start to wherever you decide to stop.
routes.shape: Two months, or as long as it takes.

fine: Priced at the Afrinkong Bespoke daily rate, per vehicle, with the destination charges — permits, park fees, border formalities — arranged by us and passed through at cost. An expedition is quoted as a whole, in writing, before anything is held.
